text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: In 1st place is <chrname>! <chrname> reaches the goooal!!

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, that's French turf!" "Holding off 
the international competition, isn't that 
a massive feat!?"

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"‘So who were the foreign runners anyway?’ 
‘WOOOOOOOO, <chrname>!’"

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"Way too many issues. You shouldn't go 
around saying you'll definitely win this 
race, you know." "Hurry up and give me the 
next schedule."

Comments poured in one after another. 
However—
choice_data_list: (I might actually be able to win...!)

text_block_list.text:
I felt like I finally got a real grasp on 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You ran hard until the very end. People's 
opinion of you all must have risen as 
well.

"I bow in response to Mei Satake's praise. 
However, our true destination still lies 
further ahead."
choice_data_list: I'll keep giving it my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the trainer's office, I ponder. 
Through her days in Project L'Arc, <chrname>'s 
abilities have improved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking back on the comments from the 
Representative Exhibition. We still 
haven't won the heartfelt trust of the 
people of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In order to gain 'supporters'... I have 
to become someone with the potential to 
take on the world, someone they can't help 
but root for passionately."
choice_data_list: ...First, let's reach the top in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain things to <chrname> when she arrives at 
the trainer's office, including how her 
abilities have blossomed through Project 
L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And together, we steel our resolve. —That 
to become the vessel of the world's best, 
we must prove ourselves on Japan's 
grandest stage: the Japanese Derby.
